text: THE DIVISIONS SAY WHAT THE DEPARTMENT SAYS. Every division, link and register was checked against dosje.gov.in on 29 Sep 2026. The ten divisions, their links and all seven registers (the Scheduled Caste lists, NCSC circulars, screening minutes, the blacklisted and de-blacklisted NGOs, Demand for Grant, the Handbook and the Rule 377 papers) already matched it row for row. Two division descriptions did not: Social Defence and the Statistics Division had been reworded, and now carry the first sentence of their live pages, in the DBIM design's Our Division and in the New design's page summaries and site search. Eight link names in the shared division list had been reworded or extended — "(e-Anudaan)", "(CPGRAMS)" and "Rule" added, "in respect of" changed to "for" — and are now the Department's own. Two live misspellings ("Grands", "tor") are corrected, and the Statistics Division's three links, all labelled "SECC 2011" on the live rail, carry their pages' own titles.
